tools.name: sap_pm_get_equipment
tools.description: Retrieve SAP PM equipment master data (description, functional location, object type, manufacturer, serial number, warranty dates) by equipment ID or functional location.

functional_location.description: SAP PM functional location code, e.g. 'PLANT-A-LINE3-PUMP01'.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_breakdown_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical breakdown/maintenance order records for an equipment, including MTBF, MTTR, downtime hours, and cost.

start_date.description: Start of the lookback window (ISO-8601 date).

tools.name: sap_pm_get_maintenance_plan
tools.description: Retrieve the existing preventive maintenance plan and planned orders (IP10 plans, IW3x planned orders) for an equipment or functional location within a date window, used to detect scheduling conflicts.

tools.name: sap_pm_get_parts_stock_status
tools.description: Check SAP PM/MM spare-parts stock status for a part number, returning whether it is in stock, on order (with ETA), or unknown.

tools.name: sap_pm_create_notification
tools.description: Stage a SAP PM maintenance notification (breakdown or observed issue) for creation. This is a write action: it returns a confirmation payload for human review and does NOT commit to SAP PM until an explicit human approval step confirms the draft, per the human-in-the-loop approval gate required for all SAP PM write-backs.

tools.name: sap_pm_confirm_work_order_completion
tools.description: Stage a work order completion confirmation (downtime hours, parts/labor consumed, closing text) for write-back to SAP PM. This is a write action: it requires a logged explicit human approval action before the confirmation is committed to the live order record.
